query:
-- Alter stems table: replace EVM NFT fields with Solana cNFT fields
ALTER TABLE stems
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS nftTokenId,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS nftTxHash,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS nftContractAddress,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS nftChain,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS mintStatus ENUM('none','pending','minted','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS solanaTxSig VARCHAR(128),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS solanaMerkleTree VARCHAR(64),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS solanaLeafIndex INT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS solanaNetwork VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'devnet',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS nftMetadataUri TEXT;

-- Extend users table: Solana wallet address length
ALTER TABLE users MODIFY COLUMN walletAddress VARCHAR(64);

-- Mint queue table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mintQueue (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  type ENUM('stem','song') NOT NULL,
  referenceId INT NOT NULL,
  requestedBy INT NOT NULL,
  artistWalletAddress VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  metadataUri TEXT,
  status ENUM('pending','processing','complete','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  solanaTxSig VARCHAR(128),
  errorMessage TEXT,
  attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  processedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Songs table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS songs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  createdBy INT NOT NULL,
  stemIds JSON NOT NULL,
  collaboratorIds JSON NOT NULL,
  stemCount INT NOT NULL,
  collaboratorCount INT NOT NULL,
  genres JSON,
  coverImageUrl TEXT,
  metadataUri TEXT,
  mintStatus ENUM('none','pending','minted','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
  solanaMintAddress VARCHAR(64),
  solanaTxSig VARCHAR(128),
  solanaNetwork VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'devnet',
  splitType ENUM('equal','custom') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'equal',
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Collaboration splits table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collaborationSplits (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  songId INT NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  walletAddress VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  stemCount INT NOT NULL,
  splitBps INT NOT NULL,
  splitPercent FLOAT NOT NULL,
  isCustom BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
